notes.generated project index (DUO-3338): duo_agency_project_index is the plugin's own derived projection of its authored projects (ordered id list + id => title map), recomputed on save_post_project. It is classified 'derived' rather than 'authored' because its ids are environment-local and its whole content is reproducible from the project posts alone — capturing it would carry one environment's local ids into another's canonical state. Duo writes project rows with direct SQL and does not fire save_post, so the projection must be repaired during apply's rebuild pass; the plugin advertises that repair itself through the `duo_providers` filter (source "plugin"), because how the index is built is a fact about the plugin's data model and not something the engine can own, version, or verify.
notes.no version_range (DUO-3338): This manifest declares no top-level `plugin`/`version_range`: the fixture plugin ships through the site repo's own code/ tree, so its version is whatever that revision carries and the code half already binds those bytes. Provider negotiation therefore checks that duo-agency-cpt/duo-agency-cpt.php is installed and ACTIVE and skips the range comparison, which is the documented behavior for a provider whose declaring manifest pins no range.
notes.project cache transient (DUO-3338): duo_agency_project_cache is an ordinary WordPress transient, so it is cleared by the engine's own closed native action rather than by the provider: a transient's storage contract is core's and means the same thing for every plugin. Both declarations are triggered on the exact canonical surface post:project, so a promotion touching nothing else fires neither.
